integrity: A complete analytic proof, a standalone reproducibility checker and a qualified originality comparison are supplied. Source priority and the theorem have not undergone independent validation.
scientific_limitations: One-dimensional reversible finite-interval killed reflected diffusions, positive finite-mean iid reset waiting times, fixed-per-experiment launch site and complete resetting; the half-line inward-drift corollary treats finite-risk and infinite-risk competitors separately. General nonreversible/high-dimensional processes not claimed. No proof that matching hitting profiles implies equal reset-clock distributions.
title: Exact global regret identity for renewal resetting in reversible diffusion
